blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Transportation (DOTr) is revisiting plans dating back to 2019 to install a cable car system in Baguio, potentially connecting the popular tourist destination to areas at the foot of the mountain city. Transportation Undersecretary Mark Pastor said that the agency is engaging with the Baguio city government, led by Mayor Benjamin Magalong, to pinpoint land that may need acquisition for the project.
